name: Mebroqualone
summary: A short-acting more potent analogue of Methaqualone.

helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet
helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

pharmacology.text: Mebroqualone (MBQ) is a quinazolinone-class GABAergic and is an analogue of mecloqualone that has similar sedative and hypnotic properties to its parent compound, resulting from its agonist activity at the β subtype of the GABAa receptor.

uses.text: It would appear that this compound was sold on the black market in Germany as a designer drug analogue of mecloqualone.

summaryZh: 甲溴喹酮（英語：Mebroqualone，簡稱MBQ）是一種喹唑啉酮類GABA能藥物，是甲氯喹酮的類似物，由於其對GABAA受體的β亞型具有激動劑活性，因此具有與其母體化合物相似的鎮靜和催眠特性。它最初是在1960年代合成的。甲溴喹酮與甲氯喹酮的不同之處在於其3-苯環上有一個溴原子而不是氯原子。

sideEffects.en: It causes sedation, poor coordination, slurred speech and memory loss. Like methaqualone, too much can cause dangerously slowed breathing, seizures and coma, and repeated use can lead to dependence with risky withdrawal.
sideEffects.zh: 它會引起鎮靜、協調變差、口齒不清與失憶。和甲喹酮一樣，過量可能造成危險的呼吸減慢、癲癇發作與昏迷，反覆使用可能導致依賴與有風險的戒斷。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它会引起镇静、协调制差、口齿不清与失忆。和甲喹酮一样，过量可能造成危险的呼吸减慢、癫痫发作与昏迷，反复使用可能导致依赖与有风险的戒断。

fact.en: It is a close cousin of methaqualone, the sedative once sold as Quaalude, with a bromine atom in place of a methyl group on one of its rings.
fact.zh: 甲溴喹酮是曾以 Quaalude 之名販售的鎮靜劑甲喹酮的近親，只是把其中一個環上的甲基換成溴原子。
fact.zhHans: 甲溴喹酮是曾以 Quaalude 之名贩售的镇静剂甲喹酮的近亲，只是把其中一个环上的甲基换成溴原子。
